title: Focus Timer CLI
summary: Build a command-line focus timer with configurable work and break periods.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: A 2-second work period precedes a 1-second break; transitions appear once in order.
edgeCases: Reject zero, negative, fractional, non-numeric and excessive durations. Test cancellation and clock advancement without sleeping.
firstStep: Separate duration validation, transition planning and display. Start with a fake clock, then connect real time.
starterContract: Return ordered work/break transitions; inject a clock into the CLI so tests never wait.
criteria: Starts a focus session from a user-supplied duration

title: Flashcard Deck CLI
summary: Create a local flashcard tool that loads a small deck and quizzes the learner.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Both cards can be visited; one correct answer in two attempts produces 1/2 for that session.
edgeCases: Empty deck, invalid JSON, missing answer, duplicate cards, whitespace and a wrong answer must not crash or reuse a previous score.
firstStep: Validate the deck first, cycle in a fixed order, then add optional seeded shuffling.
starterContract: Return validated question/answer cards; scoring and interaction belong in separate functions.
criteria: Loads cards from a documented local format
Tracks score for the current session

title: Pomodoro Web App
summary: Build an accessible browser-based Pomodoro timer using plain web technologies.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Start → work; pause freezes remaining time; reset returns to the initial duration.
edgeCases: Repeated start must not create extra intervals. Test reset while paused, tab backgrounding, keyboard-only operation and screen-reader state announcements.
firstStep: Draw idle/work/break/paused states on paper. Implement pure transitions before adding browser events.
starterContract: Return timer state for start, pause, reset and tick actions without touching the DOM.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests

title: Grade Scenario Calculator
summary: Create a calculator that helps a student estimate course outcomes from weighted categories.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The weighted result is 86%; changing the project score to 100 produces 92%.
edgeCases: Reject weights totaling 90 or 110, negative weights, scores outside 0–100, empty input, NaN and infinity. Explain rounding.
firstStep: Use synthetic category names and percentages. Keep parsing, calculation and form rendering separate.
starterContract: Return a weighted percentage only after validating weights and scores.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests
criteria: Shows at least one what-if scenario

title: Study Streak Tracker
summary: Build a local study streak tracker that records completed study days.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Under a documented yesterday-grace rule the streak is 2 and duplicate dates count once.
edgeCases: Test today present, gap, leap day, out-of-order dates, future dates and corrupted store. Document timezone and stale-streak rules.
firstStep: Define a calendar-day policy before coding; deduplicate dates and keep storage separate from counting.
starterContract: Return the consecutive-day count using an explicit reference date.

title: Markdown Notes Indexer
summary: Scan a notes folder and create a simple index of Markdown titles.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The index includes Alpha and a filename fallback for nested/beta.md in deterministic order.
edgeCases: Test empty tree, uppercase extension policy, unreadable file, UTF-8 text, traversal and an escaping symlink. Verify original files are unchanged.
firstStep: Create the fixture files in a temporary directory. Resolve the allowed root and inventory files before extracting headings.
starterContract: Return title/path records for Markdown files under the selected root; never write to the notes.

title: Secret-Safe Config Demo
summary: Build a tiny app that reads configuration from environment variables without hardcoded secrets.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The dummy key permits startup; no output contains its value. Missing configuration produces a clear redacted error.
edgeCases: Test missing, empty and whitespace-only values. Capture logs and errors; assert the fake key never appears. No actual API call is needed.
firstStep: Pass a dictionary to the config function for tests; only the entry point reads environment variables.
starterContract: Return a validated config without exposing the fake secret in messages.
criteria: Uses an environment variable for a fake API key
Fails safely when config is missing
Documents why secrets should not be committed

title: Project README Builder
summary: Create a small tool that asks project questions and generates a clean README draft.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The draft contains name, purpose, setup and usage; writing it refuses to overwrite an existing file without explicit confirmation.
edgeCases: Test backticks, angle brackets, newlines, missing fields and an existing output file. Confirm input text cannot run a command.
firstStep: Generate text in memory first. Add an explicitly selected output location and a separate overwrite decision.
starterContract: Return Markdown from bounded project fields without executing any field.
criteria: Collects project name, purpose, setup, usage
Escapes or safely handles unusual text input
Does not overwrite an existing file without confirmation

title: Adaptive Quiz Engine
summary: Build a quiz engine that changes question order or repetition based on previous answers.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: q1 is selected before q2 under a missed-first rule; saving and reloading history preserves that decision.
edgeCases: Test unseen questions, ties, repeated misses, corrupt history and removed question IDs. Compare against fixed order on the same synthetic attempts.
firstStep: Define priority rules, test selection in memory, then add validated JSON persistence.
starterContract: Choose a valid question ID with a documented priority and deterministic tie breaker.

title: AI Quiz Generator
summary: Create an optional-LLM quiz generator with a clean provider boundary and a deterministic offline mode.
author: Silentium Labs

example.source: A variable stores a named value.

mock_output.question: What stores a named value?
mock_output.source: A variable stores a named value.

expected: Offline mode returns reproducible structured questions supported by the supplied text; malformed output is rejected.
edgeCases: Test invalid JSON, missing answer, invented facts, empty source and document instructions masquerading as commands. Record mock tests separately from any provider run.
firstStep: Start with a deterministic mock provider. Make network use an explicit opt-in with a data disclosure and bounded requests.
starterContract: Validate a provider result against a documented question contract before rendering.
criteria: Validates model output before displaying it

title: Repository Activity Dashboard
summary: Build a dashboard using public GitHub API data for stars, issues, and recent activity.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Fixture mode displays 3 stars and 1 open issue, labeled as synthetic demo data; live mode labels fetch time.
edgeCases: Test 404, 403/429, offline, stale cache and hostile display text. Never embed tokens in client code or fetch arbitrary user-supplied URLs.
firstStep: Render fixtures first. Accept owner/repo identifiers, constrain the API host, then add bounded caching and retry-after handling.
starterContract: Validate a public repository API response into display-only fields.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests

title: Constraint Study Planner
summary: Generate a weekly study plan from available time, priorities, and deadlines.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Only 30 minutes fit; the other 30 are explicitly unscheduled. Never invent availability to satisfy a deadline.
edgeCases: Test impossible load, zero availability, tied deadlines, invalid dates and a task longer than a slot. Verify summed blocks never exceed each day.
firstStep: Choose whether tasks may split. State that policy, implement one-day capacity checks, then extend to a week.
starterContract: Return scheduled blocks plus unscheduled work and an explanation per decision.

title: Offline Flashcard PWA
summary: Create an installable flashcard web app that works offline.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: After the first local load, reload offline and edit the card; the edit survives another reload.
edgeCases: Test first visit offline, unavailable storage, invalid import, delete/export, keyboard navigation and upgrading cache versions. Network inspection must show only app-owned cache entries.
firstStep: Build local CRUD first; add a manifest and scoped service worker after storage works. Use localhost or HTTPS for service-worker testing.
starterContract: Validate local card data before it reaches storage or the view.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests

title: Local Notes Search
summary: Build local full-text or TF-IDF search over a notes directory.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: a.md ranks before b.md; an absent term produces a clear empty result instead of an unrelated answer.
edgeCases: Test casing, punctuation, empty query, ties, deleted files, rebuild and escaping symlink. Report index limitations and keep all note content local.
firstStep: Start with token overlap as a baseline. Measure ranking on fixed queries before considering TF-IDF.
starterContract: Return ranked source references with a deterministic tie breaker.
criteria: Shows source file for each hit

title: Secure Starter App
summary: Create a small web/API starter with input validation, tests, and documented security defaults.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Valid input reaches the handler; invalid input yields a bounded public error without stack traces or environment values.
edgeCases: Write at least five automated tests: success, missing title, wrong type, overlong body and unexpected fields. Also test malformed JSON and safe internal-error handling.
firstStep: Specify the request and response contract, implement validation tests, then choose a minimal local API adapter. Document any listener and dependency.
starterContract: Validate a tiny create-note request without needing a live server.

title: Challenge Progress Board
summary: Build a static dashboard that reads challenge metadata and shows status, owner, and completion progress.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The synthetic card shows unclaimed and no completion evidence. Unknown status never becomes completed.
edgeCases: Test missing fields, empty catalog, duplicate IDs, all filters with no matches and markup in titles. No fabricated owners or completion counts.
firstStep: Use this synthetic fixture locally; only use published metadata when showing real activity. Separate unknown, open and completed.
starterContract: Validate and normalize challenge records into display state; completion requires evidence.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests

title: Local RAG Study Assistant
summary: Build a retrieval-augmented study assistant over user-provided notes with source citations.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: A supported response cites demo-a; a question about an absent topic reports insufficient evidence.
edgeCases: Measure retrieval on at least five queries including no-match and conflicting passages. Test document prompt injection, invalid citations, deletion and explicit provider consent.
firstStep: Implement local token retrieval as a baseline. Preserve passage IDs through chunking; a mock answerer is sufficient for the free route.
starterContract: Return bounded passages with stable source IDs for a separate answer component.
criteria: Provides a local/mock mode or clearly documented provider mode

title: Offline-First Course Dashboard
summary: Design a modular course dashboard that remains useful offline and syncs only when explicitly configured.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Conflicting edits are surfaced for a user decision or retained under a documented deterministic policy; no silent upload occurs.
edgeCases: Test offline reload of courses/tasks/notes, corrupted import, schema migration, export round-trip and conflicting edits. Demonstrate sync disabled by default.
firstStep: Define module and storage boundaries first. Use two local fixture snapshots to simulate sync; a hosted service is unnecessary.
starterContract: Describe or implement an explicit conflict outcome without silently losing edits.
runtime: A current browser; Node.js 22+ for pure-function tests

title: Static Contribution Risk Linter
summary: Create a static linter that flags risky patterns in submitted source without executing it.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: sample.exe produces an extension finding; notes.md does not. Fixtures remain JSON text, never actual executable files.
edgeCases: Test traversal, symlink escape, size cap, unreadable files, false positives and narrowly scoped suppressions with reasons. A clean scan must not claim safety.
firstStep: Start with metadata-only extension checks, then add explained patterns. Bound file sizes and ensure the scanner reads data only.
starterContract: Return static finding records without importing, evaluating or running scanned text.
criteria: Scans a target tree as data
Flags blocked extensions and suspicious patterns

title: Evidence-Aware Study Agent
summary: Build an assistant that separates retrieved evidence, model inference, and uncertainty in its answers.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: This claim is evidence-backed by demo-a; a claim about exam outcomes is unsupported. Never manufacture a citation.
edgeCases: Create an evaluation set with supported, inferred, contradictory, absent and injection-bearing cases. Report observed category errors separately from interpretation.
firstStep: Write the output schema and hand-label synthetic evaluation cases before building the answer workflow. Mock inference is acceptable.
starterContract: Return evidence, inference or unsupported with source IDs and a reason.

title: Challenge Catalog Compiler
summary: Build a schema-driven compiler that validates challenge manifests and generates indexes/pages.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: A valid manifest can render escaped text; two copies of DEMO-1 produce a duplicate-ID error and nonzero validation status.
edgeCases: Test missing field, unknown difficulty, duplicate IDs, traversal, hostile HTML and input ordering. Two identical builds must be byte-for-byte equal.
firstStep: Write a schema and invalid fixtures first. Sort by stable IDs; use a text serializer without evaluating templates.
starterContract: Validate a manifest before deterministic catalog rendering; collect file-scoped errors.

title: Learning Telemetry Dashboard
summary: Design privacy-conscious local telemetry for study sessions and visualize trends.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The synthetic daily total is 30 minutes. Export contains only the documented fields; deletion removes stored events and derived data.
edgeCases: Test duplicate-event policy, negative durations, timezone boundary, empty store, retention cutoff, export and deletion. Verify no third-party requests.
firstStep: Define a minimal versioned event schema and retention policy. Aggregate local synthetic events before building charts.
starterContract: Return local duration summaries without note content or identity fields.

title: Contribution Reputation Engine
summary: Create a transparent contribution scoring prototype using merged GitHub activity without turning it into a popularity contest.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: Only demo-pr-1 qualifies under the stated merged-and-reviewed rule. Label every displayed score as a synthetic prototype.
edgeCases: Test duplicates, reverted contributions, missing review evidence and changed weights. Document gaming, bias and appeals; exclude stars, followers and commit volume.
firstStep: Keep the first prototype offline. Show raw inputs and a per-record explanation; this challenge does not ship a Forge leaderboard.
starterContract: Return explainable contribution scores with provenance; no production ranking.

title: Sandbox Design Challenge
summary: Design and prototype a safe evaluation architecture for untrusted student code without executing submissions on maintainer infrastructure.
author: Silentium Labs
expected: The default decision is non-execution. A tabletop walk-through records reject/quarantine decisions and unanswered operational risks.
edgeCases: Walk through a secret request, fork bomb scenario, oversized upload, dependency download, symlink escape and cleanup failure as text only. Do not deploy an evaluator.
firstStep: Copy the local threat-model template. Compare metadata-only review with a hypothetical disposable evaluator; justify whether execution should exist at all.
starterContract: Write a decision record and non-executing lifecycle diagram; code is optional.
runtime: A Markdown editor; no runtime or container required
criteria: Decision on whether execution should be offered at all
